title: Understanding Linear Separability
text: Linear separability means that you can draw a straight line (or hyperplane in higher dimensions) to separate the classes in your dataset. Consider how transformations can help achieve this.

title: Effect of Squaring Features
text: Squaring features can change the shape of the data distribution. Think about how this might affect the separability of the data.

title: Transformation Impact
text: Consider the transformation $$(x_1,x_2)$$ to $$({x_1}^2,{x_2}^2)$$. How does this transformation affect the data's linear separability?
